facts.what: Q2FY27 results (Sep-2026 quarter, reported early Nov-2026): Screener shows revenue Rs4,389 cr (+2% YoY), operating profit Rs831 cr (19%), other income Rs28 cr, interest Rs240 cr, depreciation Rs564 cr, PBT Rs55 cr, profit attributable Rs41 cr (EPS Rs0.25). Well below our run-rate for the second-half acceleration (our FY27E EBITDA Rs3,766 cr needs ~Rs973 cr a quarter in Q2-Q4).
Sep-2026 balance sheet: borrowings Rs15,698 cr (Rs15,551 cr incl. leases at Jun-26), investments Rs1,324 cr, CWIP Rs4,568 cr (from Rs6,987 cr at Mar-26: capitalisation).
US FDA approved Pebrilzo (biosimilar pertuzumab) on 16-Nov-2026; EU marketing authorisation on 18-Nov-2026 (first under EMA's tailored approach).

Broker changes after 30-Sep: Axis Capital upgraded to Buy, Rs395 (prior Rs405), 30-Oct-2026; HSBC Buy, target Rs440 (prior Rs460), 5-Nov-2026; Kotak upgraded to Buy, Rs390, 5-Nov-2026; ICICI Securities Sell, Rs330 (prior Rs350), 9-Nov-2026. Investing.com consensus ~Rs412 (19 analysts) in Nov-2026.
Bicara Therapeutics (BCAX) fell from $18.61 on 30-Sep-2026 to ~$17.6 on 2-Oct and ~$10.2 by 10-Nov-2026 (market value ~$0.66 bn): Biocon's 5.52 mn shares worth ~Rs540 cr vs ~Rs985 cr at 30-Sep.
